summary.intent: Run the GSD manager command center to discuss, plan, and execute three gap-closure phases (42: API unpin integrity, 43: FUSE write durability, 44: IPNS conflict handling) from a UAT audit against the CipherBox v1.1 milestone.
summary.outcome: Phase 42 fully completed (discussed, planned 8 plans, executed across 3 waves, code reviewed, verified, marked complete); Phase 43 fully completed through code review (4 plans across 3 waves merged and reviewed); Phase 44 discussed and context written but planning/execution not yet started at transcript end.

repo: The Kubo IPFS node runs with the `server` profile and swarm port 4001 exposed publicly in staging (docker-compose.staging.yml:62-72), meaning every pinned CID is advertised via DHT provider records — CIDs are public identifiers regardless of blob encryption.

The unpin endpoint (`POST /ipfs/unpin`) was guarded only by JwtAuthGuard and never read `req.user`; any account holder (signup is open via Web3Auth) could supply any harvested CID and destroy another user's pin.

Writable-share saves drop `prunedCids` without unpinning (`shared-write.ts:450`) — no legitimate cross-user unpin path exists, making the missing ownership check a real cross-tenant data-destruction surface.
BYO-IPFS unpin was broken in both directions before Phase 42; the server-side fix (swallowing 'not pinned') covers it for free.

pnpm flag forwarding breaks jest: `pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api test -- --testPathPattern=X` causes pnpm to insert `--` which jest treats as a positional regex. Correct form: `pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api exec jest --testPathPattern='X'`.

`cargo build -p cipherbox-fuse --features winfsp` fails on macOS due to pre-existing cross-compilation issues in `windows-future` and `winfsp-sys` registry crates — unrelated to Phase 43 changes; `cargo check` for project crates passes.
No `.prettierignore` existed in the repo; prettier was silently reformatting `.planning/` markdown and GSD-controlled JS files, mangling table syntax and regex pipe characters in VALIDATION.md.
1Password SSH commit signing requires `dangerouslyDisableSandbox: true` on all git Bash calls and occasionally requires restarting the 1Password desktop app when the agent returns signing errors.
The `gsd-tools query commit` helper returns `"committed": false` as a false negative even when the commit lands — always verify with `git log`, never blind-retry on that signal.
Running `worktree.cleanup-wave` with cwd inside an agent worktree causes false `base_mismatch` errors because the helper resolves repoRoot from cwd; must run from the true repo root.
The cleanup-wave helper is not idempotent: already-merged entries report `branch_mismatch` on re-run and abort the whole pass. Write reduced manifests containing only remaining unmerged entries.

code.finding: Upload compensation path calls ipfsProvider.unpinFile directly; rerouted in Phase 42 to vaultService.guardedUnpin with a D-13 race-window comment.

guardedUnpin added: acquires pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(cid)), deletes pinned_cids row transactionally, checks refcount, inserts pending_unpins outbox entry if last reference, then calls Kubo pin/rm post-commit best-effort. Cross-user attempts emit audit metric and return silent 2XX.

handle_release ordering enforced by Phase 43-02: journal.put(844) → handle.cleanup(892) → reply.ok(894) → spawn(904) → journal.remove-on-success(943). This ensures fsync-before-ack and crash-safe cleanup.

Kubo v0.40 runs with `server` profile and swarm port 4001 exposed (tcp+udp). Server profile only disables local-network discovery, not public DHT participation — every pinned CID is broadcast to DHT crawlers.
Drift report path (`runDriftReport`) contains zero `.delete(` calls — read-only by construction. drainPendingUnpins calls provider (not raw Kubo) and error-isolates per row.
WinFsp path mirrors FUSE ordering from Phase 43-03: journal.put in handle_cleanup before spawn, and MkdirPublish journaled before directory reply with conflict-retry signal.

workflow: Silent 2XX + audit metric (warn log + Prometheus counter) is the correct pattern for idempotent delete endpoints where the same response must be returned for benign races, cross-user attempts, and legitimate owns — avoids existence-oracle risk of differential status codes.

Per-CID advisory lock (`pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(cid))`) around delete+refcount closes the concurrent-unpin race without a reconciliation job; a drift report (pin ls diff) is detect-only defense-in-depth.
Transactional outbox pattern (delete row + insert pending_unpins in one txn, Kubo call post-commit) makes the unpin flow crash-safe without a reconciliation job for the new path.

For worktree execution, a node_modules symlink in the worktree may be needed to unblock lint-staged pre-commit hooks — agents should include explicit CLEANUP instructions to remove it before final status.
When a merge leaves MERGE_HEAD (auto-resolved conflicts but commit step failed), `git commit --no-edit` concludes it cleanly without re-running conflict resolution.

openapi.json drift from `nest build` side effects in main tree should be restored via `git checkout --` before merging worktrees to avoid spurious 500+ line formatting changes contaminating the merge commit.
Decision coverage gates require literal citation strings (e.g., `D-07:`) inside plan must_haves sections — mechanical grep won't match paraphrased references.
Multi-glob rm in zsh (`rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules`) aborts entirely if any glob matches zero paths — use explicit single paths or iterate.

friction: 1Password SSH signing agent errors required multiple retries and at least one full app restart, blocking commits during planning and execution gate sequences.
gsd-tools commit helper emits false `committed: false` negatives, requiring constant git log verification to avoid accidental double-commits.
worktree cleanup-wave not idempotent — already-merged entries cause full abort on re-run, requiring manual manifest reduction to list only remaining entries.
Running cleanup-wave from wrong cwd (inside agent worktree) produced false base_mismatch errors and aborted the merge pass.
42-05 merge left MERGE_HEAD unresolved after auto-resolving all conflicts but failing the commit step — required manual `git commit --no-edit` intervention.
openapi.json accumulated 564-line formatting-only drift in the main tree from a `nest build` side effect, which blocked clean worktree merges until restored.
Prettier was silently mangling .planning markdown (regex pipes in VALIDATION.md tables, test command formatting) because no .prettierignore existed — discovered mid-execution.
Planner socket error ('socket connection was closed unexpectedly') after writing plans 01-03 required filesystem verification and a continuation agent spawn.
pnpm test flag forwarding (`-- --testPathPattern`) silently breaks jest by inserting an extra `--` separator — cost time diagnosing 'no tests found' failures.
Decision coverage gate D-07 failed due to missing literal citation string in plan must_haves — required a targeted edit to 42-03-PLAN.md before gates passed.
zsh multi-glob rm aborts on first missing match — affected node_modules cleanup in worktrees.
open_items: Phase 42 SECURITY.md missing — `/gsd:secure-phase 42` flagged as required before the phase is fully hardened.
Phase 44 (IPNS conflict handling) — context and discussion complete, but planning and execution not started at transcript end.
Pending-uploads UI deferred: tray notification for WriteParked is implemented (Phase 43-04), but a full in-app pending uploads view was explicitly noted as a future improvement.
BYO provider.unpin client-side wiring deferred: server-side fix covers the advisory-row path, but the BYO SDK client still doesn't call provider.unpin on delete.
Writable-share prunedCids leak deferred: share saves drop version CIDs (`shared-write.ts:450`) without unpinning them — out of scope for Phase 42.
Rust FUSE merge conflict parity deferred: Phase 44 three-way merge and CAS logic will be TS-only; Rust FUSE parity is a separate future task.
Read-only drift report (pin ls diff) in PendingUnpinProcessor surfaces orphaned pins as metrics/logs but takes no automated action — a future cleanup job could act on persistent drift.
Phase 43-04 desktop durability checkpoint (Task 3) was auto-approved under `--auto` without live mount replay verification — manual testing of the replay-on-mount path should be done before shipping.
